channel_name: IG Share Reel to Story - Upload wait time

content: Thank you that would help me a lot!
We will forward your issue to the developers. but I don't think there is something to do for that as the issue is related to the proxy.

Is there any option to extend the 20 seconds the bot waits after "share reel to story"? 

In 50% of shares my 4g proxy is not fast enough to upload the full reel in story in 20 seconds and if story upload is not finished it then opens the profile, closes the app, opens the profile in loop but the upload is not finished even if I wait 30 minutes because of the closing and opening loop.

I recorded and attached a video for better understanding:
https://player.vimeo.com/progressive_redirect/playback/1117752871/rendition/1080p/file.mp4?loc=external&log_user=0&signature=8c9dccefb70292e74084594c093084f1996a4337a84330191a7ddbc08052d1fa

I think, If I could set the wait time from 20 seconds to 90 seconds this will fix it because if I stop the bot and manually open the profile upload is finished in 20-30 seconds.

Maybe you can add a setting to customize the 20 seconds wait time? I don't need it in UI, it could also be in some database or text file I can manually edit.
